title: Cover Schedule: Waiver, Theft, Liability, Personal Accident and Roadside Assistance
content:
Four protection products and one liability limit attach to a Wanderlane car rental. On each of the six
Car Rental Rate Classes a product is either carried in the rate or sold for each rental day at the
class's own charge. The schedule is the whole of the terms.

| Rate class | Collision damage waiver carried | Waiver, per rental day, in USD | Amount the renter still bears on a damage claim after the waiver, in USD | Theft protection carried | Theft protection, per rental day, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | no | 29.99 | 1500 | no | 13.99 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | no | 27.99 | 1200 | no | 12.99 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | no | 25.99 | 950 | no | 11.99 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0 | 500 | yes | 0 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | yes | 0 | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | no | 21.99 | 750 | no | 9.99 |

| Rate class | Third party liability cover, in USD | Personal accident, per rental day, in USD | Roadside assistance carried | Roadside assistance, per rental day, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 100000 | 8.99 | no | 7.99 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 300000 | 8.99 | no | 7.49 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 500000 | 7.99 | yes | 0 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 1000000 | 6.99 | yes | 0 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 2000000 | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 1000000 | 5.99 | yes | 0 |

## Basis Q and A

**What is the excess column?** It is the amount the renter still bears on a damage claim once the waiver
has answered. It is a figure of the class and not of the product sold: the Inclusive Flex Rate carries the
waiver in its rate and still leaves 500 USD with the renter, while the Premium Inclusive Rate carries the
waiver and leaves nothing.

**Why do the two carried classes show a per-day charge of nothing?** Because the product is in the rate on
those classes; there is no second price for it. The charge column carries a figure only on the four classes
that do not carry the product.

**Is the liability limit a charge?** No. It is the cover the class itself carries, running from 100000 USD
on the Pay Now Saver Rate to 2000000 USD on the Premium Inclusive Rate, and nothing is charged for it.
